Czech Tour 2027 rules: FMs get 25% off entry (Prague Open ≈ €38 with organiser hotel, Pilsen/Nový Bor ≈ €32); Nový Bor organiser hotel Černigov €51/night. Lienz 2027 round times and prizes (€10,800, no FM discount). Goris Open player list added (32 players, 3 GMs, avg 2263). Player lists refreshed: Rilton 109, Wroclaw 96, Groningen 89, Vardaris 85, Sevilla 63, Reykjavik 56, Pamplona 52, Graz 40, Palmanova 33, Kufstein 11. Still no 2027 rules: GRENKE, Czech Open, Teplice, Polanica, Biel, Vienna, St Veit, Faaker See, Tenkes, Cap d'Agde, Menton, Ghent, Sants, Forni, Spilimbergo, Trieste, Benidorm, European Ch. (venue not confirmed). Riga 14–20 Dec may be cancelled (no rules). New French opens (not in the app yet): Vandoeuvre 23rd Open 19–23 Dec 2026 (A 2000+, 9 rounds, 90+30, 1st €2,500, fee €60 before 4 Dec, GM/IM free), Rouen 18th Open 19–23 Dec 2026 (FIDE 498020), Noisiel Open A 2100+ 3–8 Apr 2027 (FIDE 496923); Cannes Open A is FIDE 502645. Other leads: Forintos Memorial Budapest 14–22 Dec, Fyli Christmas Open (Greece) 26 Dec–3 Jan, Armenian Men's Ch First League 12–23 Dec (Yerevan), Tegernsee 30 Oct–7 Nov 2027. chess-calendar.eu: month view works with https://chess-calendar.eu/?page=2026-12 (use ?page=YYYY-MM); ?search=COUNTRY_FRA does not filter.
